firm_data.firm_description: Sheeley LLP is a full service litigation law firm representing major hospital systems, nursing homes, assisted living facilities, managed care organizations, and other post-acute care providers, as well as individual physicians and medical professionals. The firm also provides risk and loss management services to nursing home facility client across the country.
notable_facts: The firm maintains its main office in Manhattan with satellite offices on Long Island, Westchester, Buffalo, New Jersey and Pennsylvania.
Sheeley offers legal solutions to professionals and businesses across a broad spectrum of industries and locations.

email.subject: AI for Sheeley LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Andrew,

Your multi-state footprint across Manhattan, Long Island, Westchester, Buffalo, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania caught my attention. Managing litigation defense and medical malpractice cases at that scale requires the kind of operational precision most platforms don't deliver.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of regional practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding to meet firms like yours. I'd be happy to stop by your Manhattan office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete without the overhead.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
